description: This file defines the interface for a builder pattern to create and manipulate a collection of Feature objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It specifies methods for setting, retrieving, removing, and building features, serving as a mutable builder for Feature collections.

classes.name: FeaturesBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a mutable builder for a collection of Feature objects, providing methods for setting, getting, removing, and building features, with a fluent API.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the given Feature to the builder, replacing any existing Feature with the same ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the Feature with the specified ID from the builder, if present.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple Features, replacing any existing Features with the same IDs.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific Feature from the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the Feature with the specified ID from the builder.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all Features from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable Features object containing all the Features set in the builder.
